events.text: I wanna travel to New York on Monday. Please remember that destination and day.
I have noted that you want to travel to New York this Monday. Would you like me to help you look for flights or hotels?
Actually, change the destination to Boston instead. Keep the same day.
I have updated your destination to Boston for this Monday. Would you like to start looking for travel options?
What destination did I mention originally before I changed it? And what is my current destination?
You originally mentioned New York, but your current destination is Boston. Is there anything else you would like to change?
Please repeat the city corrected day, number of rooms, and hotel preference without making any booking.
Your destination is Boston for this Monday. You have not mentioned a number of rooms or a hotel preference yet. Would you like to provide those details now?
What were the corrected day and city for the separate trip, and what was the original destination for my first trip?
Your current trip is for Boston this Monday. Your original destination for the first trip was New York. Would you like to make any other changes?
